limitations: Geometry and behavior require field calibration.
Offline trajectory replay; sliders do not rerun SUMO in the browser.
Accrued stopped delay includes external backlog and unfinished traffic.
Queues are measured on finite incoming links; backlog is reported separately.
Idle-only fuel/CO2 use assumed common fleet factors.
Queue-pressure is a constrained heuristic, not a stability guarantee.
